signals.title: ChatGPT adds restaurant reservation availability and booking handoff
signals.title_zh: ChatGPT 新增餐厅预约可用性查询与预订衔接
signals.observedChange: ChatGPT can surface restaurant reservation availability from OpenTable, Resy and Yelp and let users select a time to continue booking. The release explicitly excludes ChatGPT Work from restaurant reservation search.

relevance.tmpa: Shows an assistant surface moving from recommendation into externally grounded availability and action handoff with product-plan boundaries.
relevance.digital_employee: Useful evidence for agent work that crosses discovery, preference refinement and action completion through connected services.
relevance.codeflowmu: Relevant to connector-mediated action flows and explicit product/permission boundaries rather than direct database automation.

signals.title: GitHub Copilot web adds minimize/resume and token-spend visibility
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot Web 新增最小化/恢复对话与 Token 消耗可视化
signals.observedChange: Copilot Chat on github.com now lets users minimize an in-progress conversation, return to recent conversations, and inspect per-session and per-message token quota while work continues.

relevance.tmpa: Provides product evidence that waiting, resumption and resource visibility are becoming explicit user-facing runtime states.
relevance.digital_employee: Directly relevant to asynchronous work supervision: the user can leave a running conversation, return later and inspect its budget.
relevance.codeflowmu: Supports separating active execution from UI presence and exposing runtime resource state.

signals.title: Codex makes code-mode notifications fire-and-forget so acknowledgments cannot delay completion
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Code Mode 通知改为 Fire-and-Forget，避免确认阻塞完成
signals.observedChange: Code-mode notification delivery no longer waits for client acknowledgment; cell completion proceeds even when a notification is unacknowledged, while the legacy acknowledgment RPC remains accepted as a compatibility no-op.

relevance.tmpa: Strong evidence for separating informational events from completion-critical acknowledgments in runtime protocols.
relevance.digital_employee: Prevents a passive UI/observer acknowledgment from stalling the worker's actual completion state.
relevance.codeflowmu: Directly relevant to event-stream design: non-critical notifications should not own task completion authority.

signals.title: Google ADK adds opt-in exactly-once BigQuery delivery and final-state observability
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 新增可选 Exactly-Once BigQuery 投递与终态可观测性
signals.observedChange: ADK's BigQuery Agent Analytics now assigns event IDs before enqueue, adds an opt-in committed-stream offset mode for duplicate prevention, records offset-conflict drops, and emits sanitized final finish/error and workflow node terminal events.

relevance.tmpa: Concrete implementation evidence for durable event identity, ambiguous-send handling and terminal-state evidence.
relevance.digital_employee: Improves the ability to audit whether work actually finished, failed or was dropped rather than inferring from transient UI state.
relevance.codeflowmu: Highly relevant to evidence ledger design, duplicate detection and explicit terminal-event capture.

signals.title: Google ADK rejects config-declared stdio MCP servers by default
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 默认拒绝配置文件声明的 Stdio MCP Server
signals.observedChange: McpToolset.from_config now rejects stdio MCP server declarations unless the operator explicitly opts in, because loading an untrusted agent config could otherwise launch an arbitrary local command before the model is contacted. Remote MCP transports and code-constructed toolsets are unaffected.

relevance.tmpa: Shows that configuration provenance and execution authority must be separated: parsing a config must not silently grant local process-launch capability.
relevance.digital_employee: Supports explicit skill/tool admission boundaries for worker roles.
relevance.codeflowmu: Directly relevant to MCP/skill trust policy and fail-closed loading of locally executable integrations.

signals.title: Google ADK bounds Cloud Run sandbox execution to prevent hung agents
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 为 Cloud Run Sandbox 设置默认执行上限以避免 Agent 永久挂起
signals.observedChange: CloudRunSandboxCodeExecutor now defaults a single code execution to a 300-second wall-clock timeout instead of waiting forever, with tests covering non-terminating generated code.

relevance.tmpa: Concrete evidence that worker execution needs bounded leases/timeouts rather than an unbounded Running state.
relevance.digital_employee: A digital worker must convert non-terminating work into an observable timeout/recovery path instead of appearing busy forever.
relevance.codeflowmu: Directly relevant to stale-running detection, execution leases and recovery governance.

signals.title: Gemini CLI preserves dynamically registered MCP OAuth client identity across token refresh
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在 MCP OAuth Token 刷新中保留动态注册的 Client Identity
signals.observedChange: MCP OAuth refresh now falls back to the persisted client ID from dynamic registration when static configuration has none, and persists that identity with refreshed credentials instead of losing the refresh path.

relevance.tmpa: Shows why resumable tool sessions require durable identity metadata, not only an access token snapshot.
relevance.digital_employee: Relevant to long-lived workers that must reconnect to tools without manual reauthentication.
relevance.codeflowmu: Useful for connector credential-state persistence and recovery after token expiry.

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.227 fixes expired-session policy evaluation and action-runner command failure
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.227 修复过期会话策略判断与 Action Runner 命令失败
signals.observedChange: Claude Code v2.1.227 fixes subscription-tier feature flags when a session starts with an expired login token, fixes Bash failures in claude-code-action with allowed_non_write_users, repairs a rewind/TUI history issue, and reduces event-loop stalls.

relevance.tmpa: Reinforces that resumed or expired-auth sessions must reconstruct current authority/policy context before work continues.
relevance.digital_employee: Directly relevant to worker continuity across authentication expiry and reliable execution in hosted action environments.
relevance.codeflowmu: Supports explicit session revalidation and avoiding stale entitlement/policy state on resume.

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.79 adds ordered work queues, concurrent sessions and bounded MCP startup failure
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.79 新增顺序工作队列、并发会话与 MCP 启动快速失败
signals.observedChange: Version 1.0.79 can queue prompts, shell commands and supported slash commands to run in order after the current task, manages multiple concurrent sessions, makes MCP sandbox startup fail in seconds rather than stall, exposes effective sandbox policy, and adds enterprise policy controls.

relevance.tmpa: Strong implementation evidence for separating scheduled/queued intent from execution authority and for bounded failure before the next work item advances.
relevance.digital_employee: Directly maps to a worker inbox/queue where new work waits behind the current task instead of executing out of order.
relevance.codeflowmu: Highly relevant to the current Process Manager design: ordered pending work, explicit runtime state, fast failure and sandbox policy visibility.
